text.p: Heavy buying in Reliance Industries, amid expectations that the company might propose a bonus shares issue, pushed up Delhi shares in early trade on Monday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index was 5.20 points higher at 781.75 after first 30 minutes of trade.
Traders said foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were the main buyers on the bourse.

"FIIs are enlarging their positions in the trend-setter Reliance Industries mostly in anticipation that the company might propose a bonus shares issue," said Vijay Aggarwal of brokers Mass Financial Services.
Reliance Industries firmed 4.40 rupees to 303.40 on foreign buying, brokers said.
